description: eugr's (Eugene Rakhmatulin) spark-vllm-docker deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp recipe for DeepSeek's DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Vision-Exp (checkpoint revision 6821d6ad), MIT, served by vLLM on two Sparks. Runs eugr's published vllm-node-b12x image (nightly-20261102, `--exp-b12x` lane, digest pinned, built from spark-vllm-docker b7f6b4cd) with upstream's launch: B12X attention, MoE and linear backends, b12x load format, FP8 KV cache with block size 256, DSpark speculative decoding with 6 tokens (probabilistic draft sampling) using the checkpoint's own draft layers, deepseek_v4 tokenizer, tool-call and reasoning parsers with thinking on and high reasoning effort by default, full-and-piecewise CUDA graphs (capture size 48), eight sequences, 8,192 batched tokens and memory utilisation 0.8 (upstream default; the creator lowered it from 0.85 to leave room for host and distributed-worker allocations). Upstream sets max-model-len to `auto`; this recipe binds the context setting instead (414,976 tokens, capped from the checkpoint's configured 1,048,576 as before). Upstream's `--default-chat-template-kwargs.thinking=true` and `.reasoning_effort=high` are passed as one JSON `--default-chat-template-kwargs` value (equivalent). Upstream's instanttensor-hybrid-draft-loader and drop-caches mods are commented out and not applied. The recipe is cluster-only upstream (two Sparks). No upstream performance claims are recorded. Upstream repository MIT. Physical Spark acceptance is pending. GB10 memory correction: Per-node peak budgets utilization × 130,663,231,488-byte unified memory plus at least 8 GB for CUDA context/graphs, FlashInfer workspace, auxiliary heads and CPU/mmap buffers; 8 GB reserve, with a separate 6 GB OS floor. This is a conservative budget, not a measured footprint. Absolute KV pool: 20,619,198,464 bytes per rank, what fits the creator's 0.8 utilisation budget beside the selected weights (the creator lowered it from 0.85 to leave room for host and distributed-worker allocations); one full-context request at 414,976 tokens needs 3,466,592,256 bytes of it, so the pool holds the context with room for concurrent requests (vLLM schedules requests within the pool). This is an offline estimate; physical acceptance remains pending.
title: DeepSeek V4 Flash Vision Exp B12X DSpark vLLM two Sparks (eugr)
